responsibility: Implements common behavior for the abstract diagnostic path model. This file provides shared event meaning-to-string conversions for SARIF-style semantics, helper generation of textual event descriptions, the default no-state-graph hook for events, and path-wide reasoning such as detecting whether a path is interprocedural by inspecting logical locations and stack depths; it supplies reusable base-class logic rather than a concrete path printer or test path implementation.
same_name_distinction: This is the shared implementation half of the paths pair: it provides base-method definitions such as event meaning-to-string helpers, event description generation, and interprocedural reasoning, whereas paths.h declares the abstract event/thread/path model consumed by sinks.
